title: Bear cub with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="22" r="13" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="22" r="13" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="22" r="7" fill="#D2956A"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="22" r="7" fill="#D2956A"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="32" ry="30" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="18" ry="14" fill="#D2956A"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="42" r="7" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="42" r="7" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="42" r="4.5" fill="#3B1E0A"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="42" r="4.5" fill="#3B1E0A"/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="38" r="2.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="38" r="2.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="45" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="45" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="43" r="1" fill="#FFFDE0"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="43" r="1" fill="#FFFDE0"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="54" rx="5" ry="3.5" fill="#3B1E0A"/>
  <ellipse cx="48.5" cy="53" rx="1.5" ry="1" fill="#7A5A3A"/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d="M50 57.5 Q45 63 42 61" stroke="#5A3010" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 57.5 Q55 63 58 61" stroke="#5A3010" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="52" r="5" fill="#E8836B" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="52" r="5" fill="#E8836B" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
